registry_rule: official DPC/regional source pool filtered to the Italian Adriatic coastal corridor, plus Adriatic virtual sea coordinates

double_filter.station_stage: scripts/build_station_registry.py applies the polygon to official station metadata
double_filter.measurement_stage: scripts/filter_coastal_observations.py reapplies the same polygon to every observation row

era5_domain_note: The 39.0-46.5 N, 12.0-20.0 E rectangle remains the ERA5 grid/download domain and is not the station-selection geometry.
